mainText: Good morning. Futures are up sharply. The S and P 500 is up about one point one percent, the Nasdaq 100 up one point nine percent, and the Dow up zero point six percent. The rally is driven by Anthropic's record IPO debut today, priced at 83 dollars a share, an 81 billion dollar raise, valuing the company at about one and a half trillion dollars. The ten year Treasury yield is about five point zero eight percent, up about two basis points from Wednesday. Biggest premarket movers: Palo Alto Networks up nine point two percent after beating estimates and raising its outlook; Micron up five percent on chip strength; Vivid Seats up forty five percent on a debt cut deal; Sellas Life Sciences down twenty one percent on a discounted equity offering; and NetEase down six point five percent after a revenue miss.
